subject: Usage velocity check & temporary top-up request (Cloudly pilot)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Thompson <ben.thompson@cloudly.com>
Cc: Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Usage velocity check & temporary top-up request (Cloudly pilot)

Ben — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep the pilot stable while Cloudly ramps production traffic.

Key outcomes from today:
- You expect ~75k inference calls/day in steady-state for the recommendation endpoint.
- Average payload ~1.2k tokens per call (mostly short context + candidate list).
- Peak sustained window estimated at ~150k tokens/hour during batch re-ranks.
- Your finance target is roughly $900 per 1M tokens (target unit economics).

What we need from you (confirm by EOD Monday if possible):
1) Can you confirm the 75k/day / 1.2k tokens numbers above?
2) Expected pilot length if we approve additional credits (target go-live month)?
3) Any constraints on using credits for embeddings vs generation? (You said mainly generation.)

Proposal from our side:
- Short term top-up: $10k in trial credits applied to the pilot account to cover a month of burst testing.
- Extension: 45-day trial extension to continue parallel load testing and evals.

Attachments: usage-snapshot-may15.csv (your sample traces), mutual-action-plan-Cloudly.pdf (MAP draft).

If you confirm the numbers we’ll push an approval request internally today and loop in finance for the credit allocation. Next proposed sync: Wed, May 19 — 30-minute checkpoint to review ingestion metrics.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Ben Thompson <ben.thompson@cloudly.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@cloudly.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Usage velocity check & temporary top-up request (Cloudly pilot)

Karthik — appreciate the recap. Numbers look right from our end. Quick clarifications below:

- Confirmed: ~75k calls/day, avg ~1.2k tokens per call.
- Peak: we observed bursts up to ~180k tokens/hr in internal stress tests, planned production peak ~150k tokens/hr.
- Budget: target unit price ~ $900 / 1M tokens (this is our internal threshold for acceptable inference cost).
- Pilot timeline: we want to run extended testing through June with a go/no-go decision mid-July.
- Credits usage: prefer credits to apply to generation costs only (not embeddings), for clearer unit economics reporting.

Can you confirm how much runway $10k buys us at the $900/1M target? Also, can Redwood extend credits to end of June if we need additional time?

If helpful I attached the internal throughput snapshot we used (sending separately).

Best,
Ben
Head of Product, Cloudly
ben.thompson@cloudly.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Thompson <ben.thompson@cloudly.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Usage velocity check & temporary top-up request (Cloudly pilot)

Lauren / Marissa — forwarding Ben's confirmation and a short ask.

Quick math (please validate):
- Ben target: $900 / 1M tokens => $0.0009 per token.
- If they hit 75k calls/day * 1,200 tokens = 90M tokens/month (approx).
- Cost at target = 90 * $900 = $81,000 / month (steady-state).
- For our immediate pilot (burst testing through June) they estimate consuming ~50M tokens => ~$45k cost at their target.

Ask: can we approve a temporary credit top-up of $12,000 (instead of $10k) and extend the trial window to end of June? Rationale: $12k buys ~13.3M tokens at their target rate and should cover the next two weeks of ramp/burst tests while they validate unit economics. Conditions: credits used for generation only; we will run a consumption check on Jun 10 and re-evaluate additional funding.

If approved, I’ll communicate the terms to Ben and attach a one-line amendment to the MAP (DocuSign). Also recommend we log a HubSpot note and set a calendar reminder for the 6/10 check-in.

Attachments: usage-snapshot-may15.csv (same), MAP link + HubSpot draft in comments.

Thanks —
Karthik
